描述_EN: the symmetrical composition of the sculpture intensifies the calmness reflected in the buddha's face. behind the figure is an ornate halo or aureole, decorated with flowers and an inner ring of lotus petals. traces of red, black and green pigment on the head hint at the brightly coloured surface of the figure in earlier times. the simple clothing worn by this buddha echoes the modest robes worn by the historical buddha when he reached enlightenment after an intense period of meditation.
描述_ZN: 雕塑的对称构图加强了菩萨脸上的平静。 人物背后是一个华丽的光环或光圈，装饰着鲜花和内圈的莲花瓣。 头部有红色、黑色和绿色颜料的痕迹，暗示了早期人物表面色彩鲜艳的特点。 这位菩萨所穿的简单衣服呼应了历史上的菩萨在紧张的冥想后达到开悟时所穿的谦虚的长袍。
